capabilities: Open .html and .htm files in a dedicated view
Render pages in a sandboxed iframe
Switch between rendered preview and source view
Show HTML source with syntax highlighting and line numbers
Toggle scripts per file with a remembered permission
extras: Scripts are off by default; enabling them is saved per file path and cleared when the file is renamed, moved or deleted. Rendered pages may still load external resources that the HTML document itself references.
motivation: Built so local reports, exported dashboards, documentation pages, prototypes and generated visual artifacts can be inspected without leaving the vault.
problem: Obsidian cannot display local HTML files, so exported reports, dashboards and generated pages have to be opened in an external browser.

relations.evidence: informed by the existing Obsidian HTML viewer ecosystem, including the MIT-licensed JiaLinZhang24/obsidian-html-viewer

summary: Read-only viewer that opens .html and .htm files in Obsidian as a sandboxed rendered preview or a syntax-highlighted source view.
